name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted ROM manager and in-browser player that scans a game library, fetches metadata and artwork, and stores saves and states.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deploying: the setup wizard creates the first account, which becomes the admin.

Hasheous hash matching is enabled and needs no account. For fuller metadata, artwork and achievements, add IGDB, ScreenScraper, SteamGridDB or RetroAchievements credentials in the environment variables before the first scan.
